29b153a1fe — Refs TASK-2272 (2271 pending: PR-2843 still OPEN; I will add it with (TASK-2272) trailers once it merges).

- 2282/1-463: agy basename matches the antigravity arm; injectable ancestor walk tested (hook→sh→agy resolves to agy).
- 2277: env_dev_repo uses var_os. 2278: resolve_build_repo_from/release_repo_from tested through the home-repo fallback. 2279: --repo help + golden updated. 2276: PR-title note, no code.
Gates: targeted cargo run 248 passed (2 path-isolated launcher tests fail only on the sandbox's read-only HOME, untouched); check-ci-fast 34 passed.
subject: READY: PR-2868 (TASK-2272)
